# T_0

**T_0** is a technical variable utilized within the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] (AKDB), the national quality database for acute high-risk abdominal surgery [^src1]. Its primary purpose is period delimitation (time-frame restriction) when extracting data from the database [^src1]. As a key technical parameter, `T_0` ensures that only records from the specifically desired analysis period are included in local validation extracts [^src1].

The variable is a fundamental component of the technical guidance provided to hospitals and regions for local data validation. To ensure that reported populations accurately reflect clinical reality, institutions compare their internal Electronic Patient Record (EPJ) registrations with data reported to the National Patient Register (LPR) and forwarded to AKDB [^src1]. This rigorous comparison relies on precise variable definitions, specifically utilizing `T_0` to bound the time period, alongside other critical parameters like `Opereret = 1` and `Forloeb_SORKode` [^src1]. Ultimately, the correct application of `T_0` supports the broader clinical quality development strategy driven by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1].
